snapshot.title: Planet Hunters first-boot intro: citizen science context splash
snapshot.description: Show a full-screen splash ONCE on first launch that explains the Planet Hunters mission and citizen science connection. Users currently jump straight into tutorial mechanics with no science framing. This is the opening hook.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Splash shown once on first launch, never again (persisted flag)
Content: Planet Hunters wordmark, 1 paragraph explaining real TESS/asteroid data, 'Start Mission' CTA
Implemented as CanvasLayer overlay in AppController, shown before tutorial begins
